predecessor.reason: all required discovery roles ended as transport failures without formal reviewer output

findings.statement: A single Codex reviewer attempt cannot complete the 63-artifact, 1.30 MB frozen Bootstrap skill-route closure. The current parent accepts only one all-or-nothing read receipt, so complete review cannot progress without either lowering coverage or adding parent-validated segmented coverage.

When an outer command/session ends while run-layer waits for Codex, the child process tree can outlive its controller and its no-progress timeout. The run requires operator tree termination before the existing append-only transport failure path can close the lease.

The profile declares fallback models, but an existing preferred access-proof sidecar is reused before the selected fallback model is resolved, so an explicit fallback action cannot produce or bind an identity-equivalent proof.
